fusions.name: Ballast Drop
fusions.desc: Lets a ballast weight settle onto the target, which deals 18 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Sluice Tide
fusions.desc: Opens a sluice around you, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Becalming Engine
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to wind a becalming engine, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Padded Hull
fusions.desc: When non-fire damage reaches you, a padded hull swells around you: a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
